reviews.text:
I wish I could give this emergency veterinary team more than five stars. Dr. Tool, nurses Lucía and Romina, and the entire staff—including Jorge, Julissa, and Tandy—showed incredible compassion and humanity.

I spent the whole night there with my senior dog, Coco, who had bitten a toad and was in critical condition. The nurses stayed by his side, and the team let me remain with him all night. Jorge even bathed him, and when Coco began to recover, they prepared a room so I could stay with him.

I’ve had many emergency visits with my pets over the years, but I’ve never experienced a center like this. I’m deeply grateful for the kindness and care they showed Coco, my daughter and me. I would recommend them with more stars if I could.

Excellent place, they work with great dedication. In the six years my cat has been sick, I've never been to such a professional place. The care was top-notch; they truly helped me a lot. In other places, they treated me with no dedication whatsoever, but here they genuinely love animals and understand their owners' concerns. It's a very wholesome place, and I highly recommend it.

Overall, an incredible experience. Unfortunately, my dog was attacked by a large Shepherd late at night and was severely bitten. I quickly researched where to take her in my area and chose VEG, and I’m so glad I did.

The service was incredible, and the entire staff was kind, compassionate, and accommodating. They made an extremely stressful and frightening situation as easy as possible. They were on point with communication, timing, setting expectations, and bedside manner throughout the entire experience.

I could not recommend VEG enough. I’m incredibly grateful for the care they provided to my dog and for how they treated both of us during such a difficult moment.

An impeccable, humane, and deeply comforting experience.

This was my first time visiting a veterinary ER, and honestly, words can't express my gratitude for the quality of care we received. From the very first moment, everything was extraordinary. When I called to ask if they were open, I was immediately connected to a doctor who listened to me calmly and empathetically. When we arrived, they already knew what was wrong with my dog ​​and were expecting us.

The most wonderful thing was that I could be with my dog ​​throughout the entire process. Having that open space, where you don't feel separated from either the animal or the medical procedure, was profoundly reassuring. The staff was patient, caring, and very professional. You can tell they work with love and compassion, and that makes all the difference.

In addition to the impeccable care, the place is clean and welcoming, and everyone—from the receptionist Desiré, the nurse Antonio, Estefanía, to the doctor Omar—was kind, cheerful, and clearly knowledgeable, which instilled confidence. They explained each step to me clearly and with dedication.

And what I also want to highlight is the price: reasonable, fair, and transparent. My dog ​​was stung by a bee, a situation we'd experienced before. On a previous occasion, at another ER, we ended up paying $1,800 for the same treatment. Here we paid $370, with even better care.

I am deeply grateful. They not only resolved an urgent health problem, but they did so with a level of compassion that warmed my soul. This place is a true gift. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it without hesitation.

Thank you so much for everything you do!
Great care and kind, professional staff. Could not be more pleased. Thanks to the entire team.

I just visited for an emergency with my cat and I am so grateful for the help and service provided by the team! My cat ate one of his toys and they helped us. The team was really knowledgable, caring, thoughtful and understood the issue at hand. Thank you!! I highly recommended them!

I am so grateful to this compassionate professional team for helping a wild duck with a terrible fishing hook lodged in her. They treated her with genuine care, kindness, and did an excellent job removing the hook thoroughly and safely.

It meant so much to see how much they truly cared. Thank you for giving her a chance to recover. Highly recommend!

Max

We went to VEG vet ER in Pinecrest tonight after our dog was poisoned by a boffo frog. Dr Carter and her team immediately attended to Babka evaluating her and getting her stabilized. They exhibited both knowledge and compassion in Banka’s care. After a few hours they called us to come pick her up. We hope we don’t ever have to go back but it’s comforting to know there’s an excellent clinic in the neighborhood.

Arrived to VEG ER Pinecrest location between 1am-2am. The team that received us: Dr. Kimberly Kern, Kristal, Valerie, Erica, Janeli. They were fantastic. Their response time was impressive. The team work observed gave us reassurance we were at the right place for our baby. We appreciate their professionalism, love and dedication. Should we have another emergency, we will return to this location. We confide on their  expertise. Thank you

This group is the absolute best! Glad to see a different concept with open space. Thank you so much: Krystal, Valerie, Erika, Janely and of course Dr. Kern. We took our German Shepherd Sadie here and they did everything they could and more to save her. Unfortunately, she didn’t make it. But I feel blessed to know this team left it all there without any hesitation/paperwork protocol or hiding pet in the back.
We saw it all and we are at peace. The condition our pet had was very challenging. It was clearly her time to go. Highly recommend this place (and have tried many clinics in the past.) Best ER in So FL without a doubt! 🙏🫶

We had to bring in our Shepard due to extreme pain she was experiencing. She was whining and lethargic. As dog parents, it's disheartening when you see your pet in pain and can't alleviate it. We arrived and the staff at VEG ER we're at the door greeting us and immediately and assessing her. Dr. Rivera was kind and offered options. Stephanie was quick to make sure we we're taken care of. The meds the Dr. rendered and prescribed helped her immensely. It's going to be a road to recovery, but knowing we have an emergency option when needed, is invaluable for a loving pet owner. Thank you all for your kindness and professionalism!

The service was quick and professional, and Dr. Castillo was super nice and very patient. The staff I had at 9/24/26 at night were also very nice. I hope the doctor finds out what's wrong with Fendi and that she recovers soon.

Earth angels! Everyone was so amazing especially Dr. Kimberly Kern. So patient so informative! I went there distraught not knowing what was wrong with my Pomeranian and came home with so much peace. I am so grateful for everyone there. Thank you! 🫂 …

I honestly cannot say enough good things about this veterinary hospital and the incredible team here.

From the moment I arrived, I was treated with the utmost kindness, compassion, and humanity. Since Saturday, my cat and I had been through six different medical teams, and unfortunately, he had not received the appropriate treatment until we came here. By the time we arrived, he was in a very difficult condition.

He was hospitalized, and what meant the most to me was that they allowed me to stay by his side the entire time. They even prepared a room for me so I could be with him throughout his hospitalization. As a pet parent, being able to stay with your animal during such a scary and stressful experience meant absolutely everything to me.

I would especially like to recognize Dr. Nerea (I believe that was her name), who was absolutely incredible, as well as Miranda, who was amazing throughout the entire process. There was also another doctor whose name I unfortunately don’t remember, but I am extremely grateful to her as well. Every nurse and member of the medical staff was professional, caring, patient, and genuinely concerned about my cat’s well-being.

If you are having a serious problem with your pet, don’t waste your time and money going from one place to another. I wish I had found this hospital sooner.

I also want to make an important distinction: this review is specifically about this location and this team. It is not the same experience I had at the other Midtown location, where my cat was unfortunately given the wrong medication.

I would give this place six stars if I could. I will forever be grateful to this team for taking care of my baby and, most importantly, for treating both of us with so much compassion when we needed it the most.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart. VITTO❤️

VEG ER PINECREST, MIAMI FL THIS IS AN EXCEPTIONAL PLACE WOW!! Tuesday, September 15, 2026!!
I'm writing this very exceptional review to express our immense gratitude to this wonderful team!! During the terrifying first emergency of our beloved Canelo, our 4-year-old French Bulldog, and after my partner had a negative experience at another hospital and decided to look for another option for an urgent endoscopy that our Banfield veterinarian had ordered on Monday, my partner searched online for the best emergency hospitals in Miami and this Veg ER hospital in Pinecrest came up as the 4th best with excellent reviews. Without hesitation, she chose it and went quickly, and wow, thank goodness she didn't make a mistake at VEG ER PINECREST!! Dr. Maylin Verea and her entire team acted with such speed, confidence, firmness, decisiveness, and professionalism that they made all the difference. We were both direct witnesses to their incredible knowledge and professional experience. During the endoscopy, Dr. Verea exhausted all possibilities to safely remove the object and, most importantly, avoid invasive surgery. But what truly touched us was the simplicity, humility, kindness, and empathy of Dr. Verea and every member of her team. From the very first moment, they treated us with genuine compassion and made us feel that Canelo wasn't just another patient, but a beloved member of our family. The facility is simply beautiful, modern, innovative, and welcoming. In the midst of such a terrifying time for us, it created an atmosphere of love, trust, and tranquility. What impressed us most was the incredible transparency and connection they fostered between Canelo, our family, and the medical team. The staff even invited us to be present and observe his treatment, allowing us to see what was happening and understand each step of the procedure. Wow! That experience gave us extraordinary confidence and peace of mind. Furthermore, their prices were very reasonable, especially considering the level of professional care, technology, experience, and compassion they provided. At no point did we feel that money was more important than Canelo's life and well-being. They saved our French Bulldog, Canelo. They gave us back our peace of mind and allowed us to stay by his side throughout this terrifying ordeal. We feel incredibly blessed and fortunate to have found VEG and, especially, Dr. Maylin Verea and her wonderful team. I will proudly share our photo with these amazing angels on all platforms and websites because they deserve all the recognition in the world. I want other pet owners to know where they can find exceptional care, compassion, honesty, and humanity when their beloved pets need it most.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for saving our Canelo and for treating us all with such extraordinary kindness and love! ❤️

When my little guy presented with bloody diarrhea early on a Sunday morning, they were there to help. Service was efficient and thorough and the techs, receptionist, and vet were all exceptional. Everyone was kind and patient. Grateful to be near a 24/7 ER.

Thank you so much for taking care of our Nina! The staff and Doctors walked me through a very scary time after we thought our dog ingested some medication! They set the standard for compassion and caring for both our Nina and our family! Thanks to the Nina is back home and happy!

Hello Libia1
We truly appreciate your 5-star rating!
Everyone was so nice and helpful. We brought an injured duck here to put down. Very clean facility and they are 24 hours!

I had such a great experience here! I brought my ferret, Osito, in for an emergency and from the moment I called, I felt reassured. They let me know they would be waiting for us, and when I arrived, everyone was already aware of the situation and ready to help. The vet techs were so sweet with Osito, and Dr. Tool was amazing and took the time to explain everything to me. They made a really stressful night so much easier. I’m so glad I found a 24/7 vet that I can trust, especially one that treats ferrets! Thank you Dr. Tool and the entire team for taking such good care of Osito! ❤️
Great Team!
They where excellent with handling,n taking care of my baby boy 🐕,,definitely recommend them,,as a result "Commando ",is running playing n doing well thank you sooo much!!! …

I brought my dog Ricky to this ER twice during a very difficult episode. I want to recognize the wonderful staff members who made a difficult situation easier. The veterinarian who saw him during my first visit (Chloe Borriello) was kind, thorough, and took the time to explain everything, same as her nurse (I don’t know her name). Valerie, the other nurse in the evening , was exceptionally compassionate and worked with me to find solutions within my financial limitations. Another young staff member, whose name I believe started with E, (Elijah maybe?) also helped with Ricky’s fluids and was kind and supportive during both visits. Unfortunately, my experience with the veterinarian who saw Ricky during my second visit (Georgette Servito) was completely different. She presented hospitalization costing over $3,000 without adequately explaining what was medically essential, what needed to be prioritized, or what alternatives were available. I completely understand that emergency care is expensive, and if Ricky had been in immediate danger, I would have done everything possible to save him. But I needed a veterinarian to explain the priorities rather than simply present a $3,000+ bill I could not afford. I was also very disappointed by the military discount. The facility had already applied the military discount during my visit that morning. When I returned that evening with the same valid military ID, this veterinarian (G. Servito) refused the discount because my husband was not physically present, even though my ID is issued to me and is accepted for military benefits and discounts elsewhere and I don’t need my husband to be present. That’s why I am granted my own ID. Most importantly, I felt dismissed when I tried to ask questions about Ricky’s condition and what I should monitor at home. Even during the follow-up call with a 3rd Dr. my concerns about him not drinking were barely addressed. I understand that ER veterinarians must prioritize patients, but professionalism also means communicating with and listening to less critical cases. I am grateful for the compassionate staff members I encountered, especially Valerie and the morning veterinarian. Unfortunately, one veterinarian’s lack of empathy and communication significantly affected my overall experience.
good work of everyone else.
I hope management takes this kind of feedback seriously. Medical knowledge is obviously essential, but so are communication, compassion, and professionalism, especially when dealing with people who are frightened, financially limited, and trying to advocate for a beloved pet.
Ricky was not just another patient to me. He is my family. I expected to be treated with basic respect while trying to understand how to keep him safe. I am grateful to the people who showed me that compassion, but unfortunately, I will remember the way that veterinarian treated me just as strongly.

I have to share my experience because it was incredible. My dog, Honey, is a Golden Retriever. She's been sick for days with low calcium. I took her to a clinic called Avocado, where they prescribed medication. Anyway, that's not the point. My dog ​​got very sick in the middle of the night; one of her mammary glands ruptured and she got an infection. I went online and found this hospital, which God sent me because it's the best thing that's happened to me in my 25 years in this country. They treated my dog ​​with incredible love. They helped me with financing plans, and unfortunately, I didn't reach the maximum amount, but even so, Dr. Borriello and her girls, Genesis, Janely, and Julissa, were so exceptional. But one of those girls, whose name I didn't ask, I know was one of them. She has gorgeous curly hair, inside and out. Her parents must be so proud of that princess because she's so loving with my dog. They helped me, they treated me so well. I felt loved, and my dog ​​was the most important thing. The treatment there is exceptional. If you ever need it... don't hesitate. God bless this place and all its people, and everyone who donates. From today I will be one because I was helped thanks to everyone who contributes a little...
Absolutely phenomenal. I don’t know what I would do without them. The customer service was insane. The way they treated my cat was god Sent.  I’m so grateful.

What an amazing staff at a time where there was so much sadness thank you for assisting my son and I with our family pet and his final moment. I highly recommend this place. The staff was very cooperative, took care of us right away and assisted to our need.

I’m so grateful for the amazing care my dog received here this morning. We came in with a painful tooth infection, and the entire team was incredibly kind, compassionate, and professional. They took the time to explain everything, treated him with such care, and made what was a stressful situation feel so much easier. I truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Highly recommend this emergency vet! ❤️🐾

The vets here are absolutely amazing and fully transparent, some of the most honest veterinarians I have ever met! Dr. Verea is the best!!! Brought my sugar glider for one issue about a month ago, and hes back to being his fantastic little self, and today brought my sons bearded dragon in for what we believe is conjunctivitis and she took such good care of both of my babies!!! While they are not specialists in exotics, they are willing to help whenever and wherever they can, and shes honest about what she can and cannot do, and is happy to refer to someone who is a specialist when necessary!!! Highly, highly recommend this office!!!!!

I took my dog in due to concerns. They have me some really good options on the throughness and how extensive I would like to go on testing and we're very clear and transparent about pricing up front. I am super happy with the amazing care given with my dog. I really appreciate the team ensuring that my dog was checked out and evaluated and kept comfortable.

Everyone was so welcoming and helpful! They helped me and made a plan for my chicken, Tallulah to help her recover! VEG staff helped make her comfortable and allowed me to help during the appointment!

I’ve visited VEG five times in 3 years. Two visits at the Pinecrest location. My last visit, 8/19 with Lucy was a disaster. Five hours for no definitive answer to what was going on. I did not get discharge paperwork. I did not get records as I usually would get after the visit. I emailed and it went unanswered. Pinecrest has a lot of work to do to meet the standards VEG claims to offer.

everyone at this hospital loves animals and humans everyone that helped on my cat, billy's case especially all three doctors that were on his case. They have an amazing loving staff day and night and an amazing team it was hard on everyone and they were so loving and caring and kind with me and especially my boy there was ups and down on his health and that god he made it out but regardless he was in such good hands i never once stressed about how they were handling him and caring for him thank you all so much again sending much love from my cat billy and I.

I'd also like to add your allowed to stay with your pet as long as you want and can even sleep there. And the doctors really take their time to explain to you EVERY LITTLE thing so you feel included and they help you understand everything even the anatomy of your animal your even allowed to watch the surgeries and be close to your animal you will never once feel left out.

My nieces dog passed away earlier today and I called asking to see if they had their cremation services available. Darron answered the phone and he was the sweetest person we could have asked for. He helped us get her doggie out the car when we arrived and was nothing but gentle and sweet with us. He made a truly horrible day just a little better with his compassion and kindness. Thank you Darron for your kindness during a very rough time. Ollie is very thankful for you too. :)

I brought my pet to the veterinary service and was immediately welcomed by a friendly staff. Stephanie Castillo, the vet, greeted us with a warm smile and took the time to ask about my pet's medical history and any concerns I had.

During the examination, Stephanie handled my pet with care and gentleness. She made sure my pet was comfortable throughout the entire process and explained each step of the examination to me so that I understood what was happening.

Stephanie was thorough in her assessment and took the time to listen to my concerns and answer all of my questions. She showed a genuine interest in my pet's well-being and offered personalized recommendations for their care.

After the examination, Stephanie prescribed medications and provided detailed instructions on how to administer them. She also recommended follow-up appointments to monitor my pet's progress and ensure their continued health.

Overall, I was extremely impressed with the level of care and attention my pet received at this veterinary service. Stephanie Castillo's professionalism, compassion, and expertise made me feel confident that my pet was in good hands. I highly recommend this veterinary service for anyone looking for quality care for their furry friend.
Experience over all was great! Very nice. Wait was a little long but overall everyone was very and caring towards our dog.

I want to thank the entire staff that helped my family through a very hard sad and stressful time with our 16 yr old baby. They made the entire experience and process as easy for us to handle. So empathetic and loving first to our baby and then to our family.

Went above and beyond for our little Miles. We love you guys. Thank you

People who truly care..not only about your pet, but also about you as a person and family. They are compassionate, understanding, and genuinely committed to providing the best possible care for your pet.
My experience at VEG ER was fantastic. Every member of the staff we came across was attentive, warm and caring.

I would like to thanks to Dr Miranda, Lisbeth,  Michelle, Kirsten, Rebecca, the  US techo Paul Thompson, for the compassionate and sincere care provided to our dog Oreo on our visit to this excellent pet care ER facility, thank you to every one of you.
KUDOS TO THIS TEAM

Dobby has an inflammation for his foreskin also with little bit bleeding. We were so anxious and worried about him keep licking himself ( already booked the appointment for next morning but still feel need to buy an Elizabeth collar) Thank you Dr. Anderson for helping out! We were in such an anxiety so I kind of lost my ability to organize my language. Every one is super helpful and nice to us, I hope this place goes well and everyone be safe!

I think that VEG is good for basic emergencies, but I would steer clear for complex cases.

I have a dog with ITP. She was vomiting blood. I called my specialist and she said to get her somewhere, anywhere, I could ASAP. I live in the keys, so this was the closest emergency care I could get to. It would have been a decent visit if they would have stabilized my dog & sent me on my way to her specialist. Instead, they decided to intake her and keep her for treatment.

We were collaborating with her specialist in Boca & she was giving directions for all care. My dog was declining in their care overnight. Our specialist was contacted again in the morning again for advice. Specialist gave them all directions on what to do. The ER doctor at VEG simply responds “I don’t want to continue care.”

As much as I appreciate the honesty, I wish this decision would have been made a lot sooner. If you know as a Doctor that a dog with ITP and ongoing other undiagnosed symptoms that need further testing was not something you felt confident that your facility could provide for her, why didn’t you say that much earlier?

They were highly suggesting euthanasia within 24hrs of care. I took the last chance on saving my dog & ubered us to her specialist in Boca so that she could have the last say.

Upon arrival at our specialist she informed us that they mis-interpreted basically all of my dog’s bloodwork. They also failed to diagnose a collapsed lung, which is something that they had done ultrasounds on about 3-4 times and should have been able to see. Our specialist removed 400ml of fluid from her chest, which she said should have been removed long before, and would have been able to avoid the collapsed lung if care had been administered timely.

After seeing our specialist, my dog does not have to be euthanized. She’s still with us today. We got a proper diagnosis on the issue at hand, & treatment is possible, even with ITP.

If you have a complex case, go elsewhere. Basic emergencies I’m sure they’re fine. But they do not have the capacity for complex cases, and also apparently do not have the capacity to admit that from the start.

I made the receptionist aware of this during her follow up call & she said I would hear from the Medical director &/or manager and never did.

My experience with Dr. Servito was disappointing. From the start, she did not introduce herself, which created a poor first impression and immediately made me feel uncomfortable. Throughout the visit, she came across as distant and unfriendly, and I did not feel that she showed much concern for my pet or for making him feel better.

Unfortunately, I have had to seek care at the Pinecrest VEG location several times, and my experiences there have been disappointing overall. However, this visit stood out for a different reason. In all my years of bringing pets to veterinarians, I have never encountered a veterinarian who came across as rude or lacking compassion in the way I experienced during this visit.

For pet owners, empathy and communication matter just as much as medical care, and I left feeling that both my pet and I deserved a more compassionate experience. The key Biscayne location is way better. The Vet techs and front desk are nice and friendly.

UPDATE: I had to return with my 15-year-old senior dog, who has pancreatitis. Dr. Kern and Georgie were absolutely amazing and treated both my dog and my family with such compassion and care. They took the time to listen to our concerns, made us feel safe, and most importantly, made us feel heard during a very stressful time. Thank you for your kindness and exceptional care we’re truly grateful.

Amazing experience during a horrible time of my dog’s emergency. This place is very unique and they treat you like family and really care about your pet. Highly recommended. Dr. Gil is absolutely wonderful!!!

My fiancé and I cannot say enough wonderful things about our experience. From the moment we walked through the doors, every single person treated us with so much kindness, compassion, and respect. Most importantly, they treated our baby, Riley, as if she were their own, and that meant the world to us.

Dr. Kern is truly everything a veterinarian should be. She took the time to explain every detail, answered all of our questions with patience, reassured us throughout the entire process, and made us feel confident that Riley was in the best hands possible. Her compassion and dedication are something we will never forget.

Krystal was equally incredible. She played such a huge role in making this experience as positive as it could be during such a stressful time. She treated Riley with so much love, making sure she felt safe, comfortable, and cared for every step of the way. She also went above and beyond to comfort my fiancé and me, always checking on us and making us feel supported.

The entire staff that night was absolutely amazing. Every person we interacted with was kind, compassionate, and genuinely cared about both Riley and our family. It never felt like we were just another appointment—they treated us like family.

These amazing people were truly angels sent by God, and we will be forever grateful for the love, care, and compassion they showed us. Thank you for giving Riley such exceptional care and for making one of the most difficult moments of our lives so much easier. We will never forget everything you did for us.
Dr. Tool is very nice. They helped us out.
I had an amazing experience with VEG. Specifically with Dr. Tool. She was so kind and genuine. I will 100% be back in case of another emergency.

Highly recommended! Excellent service and top-notch professionals
I want to express my sincere gratitude and highly recommend VEG ER for the incredible care they provided.
What stands out the most about this place is:
Accurate and professional diagnosis: The medical management was precise, thorough, and impeccable.
Fast, specialized exams: The entire testing process was handled with impressive speed, which is vital in an emergency.
Fair pricing: They offer top-tier medical attention at completely reasonable and transparent rates.
They have an excellent team. A special thank you to Dr. Tool, Nurse Erika, and all the staff—especially Jorgie and Janely—for their dedication, warmth, and outstanding professionalism.
I highly recommend this place and their entire team of professionals. Thank you for everything!

Dr. Servito and Nurse Romina
Excellent care from both Dr. Servito and Nurse Romina. Both are very professional and very kind, both in their treatment of my dog ​​and with us, as we are senior citizens. Thank you so much.
The team at VEG were amazing! Dr Omar, Genesis, Annette, Dr. Tool, Crystal and Tiffany - thank you so much for caring for Mckayla, I am forever grateful.

We truly appreciate your feedback and are grateful for the opportunity to learn from your experience. If you could share any additional details, it would help us enhance our services. Thank you for your support.

When yesterday because my cat 🙄 swallowed a needle .
The treatment that I and my cat received was above expectations. Between Castillo Romina Anthony and Rebecca they take care of my cat in a professional way , I was even next to them when they were working on him.
Bonch of young very enthusiastic team.
Thanks
They healed my cat and helped me so much with payment and as a broke college student them saving my best friend meant the world to me
Wonderful experience in caring for our dog in this unforeseen emergency.

I recently was referred here by my vet to get a feeding tube for my 9 year old cat who had a colectomy about two weeks ago due to extreme constipation. The colectomy was done at my normal vet and everything went well. However, my cat refused to eat so our vet suggested getting a feeding tube and going to VEG ER for Pets.

At VEG, the moment I walked in, my pet and I were treated so nicely and with so much care by everyone in there. My main nurse was Yani and the feeding tube surgery was done by Dr. Miranda. Both of them were just so warm and really cared about the wellbeing of my cat.

There was a bit of a wait from getting seen by the nurses to actually getting the surgery but it was understandable as the focus was to stabilize the more critical patients and then attend to the others who did not require immediate attention, such as my cat.

I was allowed to watch the surgery in person and it made me feel reassured that my cat was receiving the best care possible. My cat had to stay one night and they offered me to stay the night with him. My allergies was being horrendous, so I couldn’t.

When I went to pick him up the next day, I received the same warmth and care from the staff as I did the day before. We did have to wait a little to get discharged, but, again, that is completely understandable. At discharge, I was told everything that I needed to know about giving food through the feeding tube and how to care for it.

The things I loved the most were the transparency and hospitality. There are snacks and soft drinks/water available while you wait. And the whole time that your pet receives care, you are allowed to be there with them, so you see exactly how they are being treated. They are so gentle with all the pets and you can tell all the staff actually care about these animals’ wellbeing.

Another amazing thing is that they work with you on pricing. There are several options to pay and even if you don’t have quite enough, they will work with you to make sure that your pet is given the best care possible.

Overall, I hope I never again have to face a situation where an ER vet would be necessary, but if I did, I’d definitely go to VEG.

Unfortunately, I came to know this place in the worst way. My 15-year-old Chihuahua was attacked by another dog while we were walking. I took her to another vet in an emergency—I won't even mention their name because they were irresponsible—but at least they gave me a choice of another 24-hour vet, and I chose VEG. From the moment we arrived, the attention was exceptional, kind, and compassionate. I was completely devastated by what had happened, but they were totally professional. They started treating my beloved dog, Chiki, who, after four hours in intensive care, couldn't make it and passed away. They were very professional in offering their condolences, hugging me and my children, who were devastated. I won't be returning for that same reason, but I do recommend them 100%. A thousand thanks to the nurses and the doctor who were there for me at all times when I needed them most.

When our sweet Cooper needed emergency care, we were terrified. He is a 6 year old lovable dog that is epileptic. But, the entire emergency team at VEG Pinecrest turned a difficult moment into one filled with compassion and genuine love.

Dr. Kern and Dr. V were Cooper’s attending veterinarians, and we truly could not have asked for better hands or bigger hearts. They were thorough, patient, and incredibly kind, taking the time to explain every step and helping us make informed decisions during an emotional time. Their calm presence and clear communication gave us comfort when we needed it most.

Genesis, Romina, and Rebecca were equally extraordinary. It was so evident that they deeply cared for Cooper — not just as a patient, but as a beloved family member. They treated him with tenderness and respect, and they treated us with empathy and understanding. Every interaction felt sincere and supportive.

You never want to find yourself needing an emergency vet, but if you do, this is the team you hope for. Their professionalism, compassion, and heartfelt care made all the difference for our family. We are forever grateful for everything they did for Cooper.
Great care was taken to remove a foreign object from our pet. The staff was attentive knowledgeable and skilled. If we ever needed pet care again we know where to go.

They saved my cats life and I couldn't be more greatful!!!!!!!! The staff was incredibly warm  and kind.They were quick to diagnose  and treat and the veterinarian was absolutley wonderful!  I will always back this place 💯! I live in key largo and drove up for prompt care.  My boy is alive because of you! From the bottom of me and my family's heart ❤️  THANKYOU ! Mini will be in our family for years to come and its all thanks to this place !

Thank you so much for the 5 stars! It truly means the world to us to know you had a great experience. We pour our heart into what we do, and reviews like yours remind us why we love it. We look forward to seeing you again!
I would highly recommend to anyone. Thank you Romina and Omar for being attentive, gentle and caring with my pet rabbit. You guys were great!

This place is highly recommended. You never want to go to these places in an emergency, but if you ever have to, I recommend it 100%. Dr. Miranda is incredible; she was very professional and listened to all our concerns, advising us in every situation. The rest of the team—the night doctor, the nurses, and the assistants—I don't know everyone's names, but they were all wonderful to my pet and to us. Both the day and night shifts were fantastic. You can really see their genuine love for animals, and they treat humans well too. We felt very well cared for, and that my dog ​​was in very good hands. Thank you so much from Lola and all of us ❤️
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your trust in our team and are so glad we could be there for you and your pet.
The service was amazing they did everything they could to leep my dog comfortable and taken care of. Doctor Servito does amazing work and Romina and rebecca were amazing

Amazing place with an amazing team! They had a test on hand that my vet did not and spent a thorough amount of time with my dog and I reviewing his history and explaining how to perform the test. The kindness of every employee that I have interacted with at this facility is through the roof and I am so thankful to have them during such a stressful time. Additional perk: parking is plentiful!

Needed emergency services this evening for our cockatiel who hurt her little foot and the wound wouldn’t stop bleeding. Fearing the worst could happen I ran to Google to find the closest veterinarian still open and was so very fortunate to find Veterinary Emergency Group in Pinecrest.

My call was answered quickly and after a very brief conversation with a staff member, I was advised to bring our bird in for an emergent exam.  The staff member also informed me that she would be alerting the team that we were coming so they could be ready for us.

Upon arrival I was greeted by one of the vet nurses and once I identified who we were he very quickly brought us to a room and the veterinarian on staff met us there shortly thereafter.  The vet nurse that greeted us handed off care to the nurse in charge of our baby’s care.

Assessment from both the nurse and the veterinarian were swift yet thorough and the plan of care was phenomenal.  I’m an RN with a quality assurance focus as well as a former vet tech so I’m a pretty tough critic.  Did I mention their bedside manner? Because it was top notch!

Costs were slightly less than I expected which was great!  But honestly for the quality of care our bird received combined with the amazing bedside manner I truly feel I got the deal of the century with this facility.

Of note: A dog with a life threatening emergency came into the facility during our stay and the team handled that case phenomenally as well.

I hope I won’t be needing emergency veterinary services again in the future but should I need them I know exactly where I’ll be bringing my pet- straight to VEG in Pinecrest!

P.S.
The names of the staff members are escaping me right now but I’m hoping I can add them to this review later.  If not:
-Person on the phone was female and I called at appx 6pm
-First nurse was a male and mentioned he was the nurse on the “inpatient side” or something to that affect
-I believe the name of the vet is Dr. Omar
-Nurse that was in charge of our case was a female (braces, long dark hair)

Edit:
-Rebecca answered my phone call
-Jorgie was the vet nurse that greeted us
-Dr. Omar was, indeed, the name of the veterinarian
-Romina was our stellar vet nurse in charge of our case

The whole staff was supportive through the process while we were anxious parents. Gaby was kind and talked us through the whole process, and was transparent of the treatment plan and pricing for services before they were performed. We also had the option without judgement to accept or deny care based on our opinion/ budget.

This staff is HEAVEN SENT. I came in with my cat because of an infected abscess they treated us so amazingly. They were able to work with me and get him the care he needed🥹 DR. Tool , genesis, and Rebecca are angels. Couldn’t be happier with my experience here. …

Thank you to the entire VEG ER for Pets team at Pincrest! When a pet dies, they take a piece of our hearts with them; those are indescribable moments of pain! Our Stephy passed away on the way to the hospital, and the whole team received us with incredible care, trying to revive her! It was a very difficult time. Congratulations on your professionalism! But most importantly, you treated us with so much love and empathy, and I will be forever grateful for that! I haven't seen young people with so much heart in this country. Thank you always! ♥️

This was the first time having to go to an emergency vet and I was blown away by the care and hospitality of the staff! The staff were extremely helpful, comforting, friendly and informative. Rebecca’s awesome! I spent most of my time there with her and she had an amazing vibe. I felt comfortable leaving Simba in such great hands as he did have to stay for observation. I was updated frequently on his condition. They offered me a room to stay over with my dog to stay the night too, which was unheard of to me! Dr. Tool took good care of my Simba. Overall I would recommend this place 100% for all your fur babies. Thank you VEG!

The best place, the best service, and very helpful; they helped Teddy so much ✨
Excellent service, wonderful people, especially Rebecca! She was so nice, I loved her! Thank you for everything
This was an incredible experience. Our dog Hugo ate a sock and he was seen efficiently and carefully. Highly recommend!

Our 6 year old Yorkie Leo was bit by a large dog on a walk in the neighborhood and suffered multiple bite wounds.  Over the last 3 months, Leo has been a daily visitor to his vet to treat the wounds. He had multiple surgical procedures and daily bandage changes, as well as numerous prescriptions.  He had little to no appetite which was coupled with a persistent fever.

We had two instances where we visited VEG ER, once for an emergency procedure and another to help with a wound cleaning.  The customer service and care we received was excellent.

I’m happy to say that after some real touch-and-go periods, Leo seems to have turned the corner and is on his was to recovery.

Thank you VEG ER for assisting in Leo’s recovery!!!

You walk right into the area where your dog is seen and treated (rather than into a waiting room). Staff was amazing and empathetic. So patient with all my questions (I had so many). Helped me feel calm when anxious over my dog, especially that it was in the middle of the night. They give you a quote with options on what you would like to proceed with and respect your decisions.

Thank you all so much for your compassion during my raccoon situation. It truly means a lot to know there are animal hospitals willing to take the time to examine an animal and thoughtfully determine the most humane next steps—especially at no cost. You make it possible for the animal lovers at Cauley Square to continue caring for and advocating for the voiceless animals in our surrounding community.
